title: Mistune Markdown image and link parsing can exhaust CPU
summary: Nested image openers and empty-label links trigger separate quadratic-time parsing paths in the default renderer without plugins. Small crafted Markdown documents can occupy a worker for extended periods.

severity.rationale: Untrusted documentation or model output can reach a denial of service in Markdown rendering. The documented flaws do not establish code execution.

exposure: Applications rendering attacker-controlled Markdown with the affected inline image or link parser are exposed.

params.instructions: Check mistune version, affected release line and the documented exposure conditions.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.risk: Medium. Updates can interrupt workflows and require compatibility checks.

verification: Confirm the deployed release meets the corresponding fixed version and verify the affected workflow with harmless test inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
